Work with infrastructure, network, security, identity, and application teams to ensure the VDI platform remains secure, resilient, scalable, and operationally efficient. Workstation OS - 5+ years of experience managing and optimizing Windows 11 in both physical and virtualized environments. Scripting - Experience with management and automation scripting in PowerShell and VMware PowerCLI. Comfortable performing tasks from the command line. Collaboration and Mentoring - Ability to work effectively with IT teams, communicate strategy clearly, and provide practical guidance where needed. Microsoft Intune - Experience with modern endpoint management strategies, zero-touch provisioning via Autopilot, policy management, mobile device management, Microsoft Graph, and log analytics. AD / Entra ID - Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and Microsoft Entra ID. Cross-functional Troubleshooting - Ability to diagnose issues across endpoint, virtual desktop, identity, network, storage, security, and application layers. Desirable Knowledge And Experience College degree in Engineering, MIS, CIS, or related discipline. Experience with Horizon App Volumes, Dynamic Environment Manager, monitoring platforms, VDI capacity planning, or protocol-level performance troubleshooting. Experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, StoreFront, NetScaler / ADC, or Citrix app layering technologies. Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365. Experience with scripting languages such as PowerShell, VBS, or Python for automation tasks. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
